note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. MHCLG Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset provides local-plan coverage boundaries; specification requires a boundary reference, Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and responsible organisation code, and states that an exact planning-authority boundary may use the planning-authority boundary reference. This materially changes source family/method from ONS postcode/LAD lookup to official local-plan coverage geometry plus organisation reference. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference, organisation/local-authority code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, LPA/LAD code/name, or equivalent identifier selecting one of the coverage geometries without guessing. Therefore no source-area geometry can be bound to this slot, accepted_count remains 0 and source_area_count remains 0; no accepted Plan0 package emitted.
